name: pawtyk
description: PawTyk — a cozy logic puzzle. One animal in every row, column and color (two from level 21); sanctuaries that grow with every puzzle you solve.

scripts.pack:build: tsx scripts/build-level-pack.ts --write && tsx scripts/build-journey-pack.ts --write && tsx scripts/build-journey-pack3.ts --write && tsx scripts/build-journey-pack4.ts --write
scripts.pack:check: tsx scripts/build-level-pack.ts && tsx scripts/build-journey-pack.ts && tsx scripts/build-journey-pack3.ts && tsx scripts/build-journey-pack4.ts
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.fb:test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-pawtyk "FIREBASE_RULES_TEST=1 vitest run test/firebase"
scripts.fb:emulators: npm run fb:build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-pawtyk
scripts.fb:deploy: npm run fb:build && firebase deploy --only functions,firestore
